name: Giuseppina Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Giuseppina was born on 26 July 1811 and baptized two days later, daughter of Vincenzo Ferlaino and Maria Colosimo (S1). An elder sister of the same name, born in March 1810, died as an infant (S2). Giuseppina married Carmine Fiorillo, a contadino from Savuto in the Aiello area, in a civil ceremony on 1 March 1840 and in church on 3 March 1840 (S3, S4). Their son Domenico followed in December. She was buried at San Mango on 1 February 1877, aged 70, as the daughter of the late Vincenzo and Maria Colosimo (S5). The index misprints her first name as 'Joseph'.
